notes: Agent Forge fixes for big libraries. Exams are graded fairly: a right answer passes however it is written (tables, other words), while a wrong number, name or file still fails, and your past exam results are re-graded automatically. Exams now ask one thing with short exact answers, and the quiz sees the file the exam came from. Study reads big project folders properly: Unity and Unreal caches, logs, lockfiles and minified files are skipped, docs are read first, and every folder gets a fair share. Questions only come from real documents, so logs no longer cause odd questions. Research reads each topic's Wikipedia article and official docs pages (Blender manual, MDN). Tip: press Study again on agents trained before this update.
